capabilities: alternate list characters between consecutive lists
keep consecutive lists visually separated in reading mode
generate markdown that stays compatible with other parsers
extras: The README stresses that output markdown remains standard and the notes do not depend on the plugin once edited.
problem: In Obsidian, two lists written back to back with the same list character merge into one list in reading mode, even when the author intended them to be separate.
summary: List-marking plugin that alternates list characters between consecutive lists so they render as separate lists in reading mode.
